name: cookly
description: Cookly - recipe finder and manager (Express API + React app)
author: Pratham Masurkar

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix cookly-backend install && npm --prefix cookly-frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix cookly-backend run dev:memory" "npm --prefix cookly-frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:db: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix cookly-backend run dev" "npm --prefix cookly-frontend run dev"
